title: Assistant Management Accountant
description:
Assistant Management Accountant
Sheffield, South Yorkshire

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an ambitious finance professional to join a growing business as an Assistant Management Accountant.

The role would suit either a Finance/Accounting graduate looking to start their career in management accounting, or someone with existing finance experience who is looking to take the next step, broaden their exposure and progress their career.

This is a broad, developmental role offering exposure across management accounts, financial control, commercial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, FP&A and business partnering. As you develop, you will gain increasing involvement in forecasting, budgeting, commercial analysis, and process improvement.

Key Responsibilities
- Prepare monthly management accounts, journals, and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Analyse P&L performance, investigating variances and providing commentary.
- Produce sales, margin, and management reporting.
- Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow forecasting.
- Provide financial analysis to support commercial decision-making.
- Work closely with Finance, commercial and overseas stakeholders.
- Take increasing ownership of financial analysis and business partnering as the role develops.

About You

We are open to candidates at different stages of their finance career, including graduates and those already working in finance who are ready to step up and progress.

You are likely to have:
- A relevant degree and/or previous finance experience.
- AAT qualified or studying towards CIMA, ACCA, or equivalent.
- A good understanding of accounting fundamentals.
- Strong Excel skills and confidence working with financial data.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisation.
- Good communication and relationship-building skills.
- A proactive, inquisitive approach and desire to develop.

What's on Offer
- Professional study support
- Hybrid working
- Life assurance
- Healthcare cash plan
- Exposure to management accounting, FP&A and commercial finance
- Opportunity to work closely with senior Finance and commercial stakeholders
- Clear scope for career development and increasing responsibility

title: Credit Controller/Accounts Assistant
description:
Credit Controller & Accounts Assistant

Overview

Our client is a well known Sheffield-based manufacturing business with a long, proud history.

We are recruiting for Credit Controller & Accounts Assistant to join their Sheffield team on site. The role combines customer credit control with day-to-day accounts work, supporting invoicing, payment allocation and month-end tasks. You will work closely with the finance team to maintain accurate accounts, reduce overdue debt and ensure timely reconciliation.

Key responsibilities
- Manage customer accounts and proactively chase overdue invoices to reduce days sales outstanding.
- Prepare and issue invoices, credit notes and customer statements accurately and promptly.
- Allocate customer receipts and reconcile bank transactions and ledgers.
- Support month-end close with account reconciliations and assisting with journal entries.
- Maintain accurate credit records, assess customer credit risk and raise queries where needed.

What we are looking for
- Previous experience in credit control and general accounts administration.
- Excellent numeracy, attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Confident use of accounting software and spreadsheets.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills with customers and internal teams.
- AAT or equivalent accounting qualification desirable or working towards one.

Package and benefits
- £28k to £30k (negotiable)
- Study support for accountancy qualifications

Next step
- Submit CV to the Shillito Group consultant for initial review.
- Telephone screening with the recruiter to discuss suitability and availability.
- Interview.

Shillito Group is a specialist recruitment and executive search partner, working with ambitious businesses to secure high-impact talent across commercial and engineering markets. Our reputation is built on deep expertise, trusted relationships and delivering results that go beyond the brief.

- Working knowledge of Microsoft products and IPS.
- Good report writing skills

- Strong work ethic with the ability to work to tight deadlines

title: Credit Controller
description:
Sharp Consultancy are working with a successful business in South Sheffield who are looking to recruit an experienced Credit Controller on an initial 9 month contract.

This is a hands on role where you'll be joining a busy finance team and playing a key part in bringing down an existing aged debt backlog. The business is looking for someone who can hit the ground running, take ownership of their workload and make an immediate impact.

There is also the view of permanent employment once the initial contract has been completed and the backlog has been brought under control.

What will you be doing?

The role is varied and will cover a broad range of credit control and transactional finance duties, including:
- Managing a portfolio of customer accounts and reducing aged debt
- Chasing outstanding payments by phone and email
- Allocating cash and keeping customer accounts up to date
- Raising invoices using an ERP system
- Completing account reconciliations
- Investigating and resolving payment and account queries
- Using Excel to analyse and manage financial information
- Working closely with internal teams and customers to resolve outstanding issues
- Helping improve processes and maintain accurate financial records

What are we looking for?

We're looking for an experienced Credit Controller who is confident working in a busy environment and can get up to speed quickly.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a Credit Control role
- Experience chasing debt by both phone and email
- Good knowledge of cash allocation and account reconciliations
- Experience raising invoices
- Previous experience using an ERP or finance system
- Good Excel skills
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- A proactive approach and the ability to work independently
- The availability to start at short notice

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller looking for a role where they can make a genuine impact quickly, with the potential for the position to become permanent.

If you're available immediately and this sounds like the right opportunity for you, get in touch with Sharp Consultancy today.

Sharp Consultancy is a finance and accountancy recruitment specialist assisting accounting and finance divisions of businesses in the Yorkshire and Derbyshire area. With over 30 years' experience we pride ourselves on sourcing excellent finance professionals across all divisions of an accounts function.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK full time without restriction. To apply please send your CV to the e-mail address stated, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications, we receive it is not always possible to respond to unsuccessful applicants. Therefore, if we have not responded to your application within seven days, please note that on this occasion your application has not been successful.

title: Audience Development Coordinator - Local Authority - Libraries
description:
Audience Development Coordinator
- Hourly Rate: £15.56 PAYE
- Location: Central Sheffield
- Job Type: Hybrid (office and home working)

Join Sheffield Libraries as an Audience Development Coordinator and play a key role in bringing a vibrant programme of events and activities to life. This position offers a unique opportunity to engage with the community through a variety of events, from author talks to large-scale activities like Comic Fest and the Summer Reading Challenge.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Plan and coordinate a diverse range of events across Sheffield's libraries.
- Develop creative ideas for future events and activities.
- Support the execution of events such as author talks, history talks, re-enactments, Comic Fest, and the Summer Reading Challenge.
- Organise the upcoming Book Awards.
- Handle event administration and complete relevant forms.
- Coordinate payments for external contributors and suppliers.
- Promote library events through social media and create newsletters to showcase upcoming activities.
- Attend events to ensure smooth operation, meet and greet the public, authors, speakers, and other guests.
- Introduce authors and speakers at events as required.
- Conduct outreach and networking to develop relationships with individuals, groups, and organisations.
- Collaborate closely with colleagues and different teams across the library service.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Friendly, enthusiastic, and approachable demeanor.
- Creative mindset with a knack for suggesting innovative ideas.
- Highly organised with strong coordination skills.
- Confident in communicating with a diverse range of people.
- Experienced in delivering excellent customer service.
- Skilled in networking and building new relationships.
- Comfortable supporting or hosting public events.
- Proficient in using social media and creating promotional content.
- Able to balance creative initiatives with established processes and procedures.
- Capable of working both independently and as part of a team.
- Experience in events, community engagement, audience development, or related fields is advantageous.

Benefits:
- Flexible hybrid working arrangement, with approximately three office days per week.
- Opportunity to work on engaging and diverse events.
- Chance to meet a wide variety of people and make a significant impact in the community.
- Competitive hourly rate and time off in lieu (TOIL) for occasional evening or weekend work.
- Saturday overtime paid at time and a half.

How to apply:

If you're an organised, creative, and confident communicator who enjoys events and engaging with people, apply today to become part of Sheffield Libraries. Please submit your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this position.

title: Administrator
description:
Administrator

Doncaster

Up to £27,000 per annum

Full Time, Permanent

We are currently recruiting for an Administrator to join a well-established and friendly law firm based in Doncaster. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and professional individual looking to build a long-term career within a supportive office environment.

Previous invoicing experience would be advantageous but is not essential, as full training can be provided.

Key Responsibilities:
- Providing administrative support to solicitors and the wider team
- Managing incoming calls, emails and correspondence
- Preparing, formatting and proofreading legal documents and letters
- Maintaining accurate client records and filing systems
- Scheduling appointments and managing diaries
- Processing and distributing post
- Assisting with invoicing and billing administration
- Updating internal databases and case management systems
- Handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism
- Supporting general office administration duties as required

The Ideal Candidate:
- Previous office administration experience
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office packages
- Ability to prioritise workloads and work to deadlines
- Professional and personable approach
- Previous invoicing or finance administration experience is desirable but not essential

Benefits:
- Competitive salary of up to £27,000
- Full training provided
- Friendly and supportive working environment
- Opportunity to develop within a reputable law firm
- Stable, full-time permanent position

If you are a motivated and organised administrator looking for your next opportunity in Doncaster, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Contact Centre Agent
description:
Location: Doncaster Contact Centre
Salary: £26,116 rising to £26,738 after 8 months, plus uncapped commission

Looking for a role where your personality can earn you money?

If you're naturally chatty, enjoy helping people and love the buzz of achieving goals, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for.

Whether you've worked in retail, hospitality, customer service, or another customer-facing role, you already have the skills to succeed. At EE, we'll give you all the training, tools and support you need to build a rewarding career, earn uncapped commission and help customers get more from the technology they use every day.

Join our Doncaster Sales Team and you'll be speaking with existing EE customers, understanding what matters most to them and matching them with the products and services that best fit their needs. From the latest smartphones and broadband packages to smart home technology and entertainment products, every conversation is an opportunity to make a genuine difference.

What's in it for you?
Competitive Pay
Starting salary of £26,116
Rising to £26,738 after 8 months
Uncapped monthly commission, meaning the more successful you are, the more you can earn
Brilliant Benefits
24/7 Online GP access for you and your immediate family
Discounts on EE and BT products, potentially saving you hundreds of pounds each year
Free on-site parking
Generous family-friendly policies including market-leading carers leave
Flexible banking of hours to support work-life balance
Career Development

We're passionate about helping our people grow. Whether you want to become a Team Leader, Coach, Trainer, Manager, or explore opportunities across EE and BT Group, we'll support you every step of the way.

Great People

You'll be joining a supportive, social and inclusive team where success is celebrated and colleagues genuinely help each other thrive.

What you'll be doing

As a Sales Advisor, you'll take incoming calls from existing EE customers and:

Build great relationships through meaningful conversations
Understand customers' needs by asking the right questions
Recommend products and services that genuinely improve their experience
Help customers get the most from their technology
Deliver an outstanding customer experience on every call
Achieve individual and team performance goals

You'll become an expert in our products and services, but more importantly, you'll learn how to understand people and find solutions that work for them.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Let's clear a few things up.

"It's cold calling"

Not here.

All calls are incoming from existing EE customers. You'll focus on understanding their needs and helping them find the right solution.

"It's hard selling"

Definitely not.

Customers are already interested in our products and services. Your role is to listen, understand what's important to them and help them make informed choices.

"It's all about targets"

There are targets, and many of our people genuinely enjoy the challenge. But success here isn't just about numbers. It's about building trust, solving problems and creating great customer experiences.

You'll probably love this role if
You enjoy talking to people

You've worked in retail, hospitality or customer service
You enjoy achieving goals and being rewarded for success

You're naturally curious and enjoy learning new things
You like helping people find solutions

You're enthusiastic about technology and keeping connected
You thrive in a team environment where everyone supports each other

Many of our top performers joined us from retail, hospitality and other customer-facing backgrounds, bringing transferable skills that helped them succeed from day one.

Working Hours

We operate on a rotational shift pattern that offers variety and regular days off throughout the week.

Key benefits include:

No overnight working
Regular extended weekends and consecutive days off
Advance visibility of your shifts
Flexible time-banking options to support work-life balance

Why EE?

At EE, we're connecting people to the moments that matter most.

Every day, you'll help customers stay connected to friends, family, work, entertainment and the technology they rely on. In return, we'll provide the support, development opportunities and rewards to help you build a successful career.

Bring your energy, ambition and personality and we'll help you turn your potential into performance.

Apply today.

title: Recruitment Account Coordinator
description:
Permanent - Full-time - On-Site - Monday-Friday

Shift pattern: 9am - 6pm and 11am - 8pm (swap each week)

Salary: Up to £29,000 per annum + bonus

Have you considered a career in driving recruitment? Do you possess drive, ambition, discipline, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment? If you're passionate about people and delivering exceptional service, this is your opportunity to join the UK's largest recruitment business and build a rewarding career with Staffline.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Recruitment Account Coordinator to support our growing Driving Division, supplying professional drivers to a range of leading transport and logistics client in Barnsley.

This is a fast-moving role where no two days are the same. You'll be responsible for ensuring our clients have access to reliable, compliant, and skilled drivers while delivering a first-class experience to both candidates and customers.

Previous recruitment experience is beneficial but not essential. If you have transferable skills from customer service, transport, logistics, operations, or administration, we'll provide the training and support needed to help you succeed.

What You'll Do as an Account Coordinator

This role is all about building relationships, solving problems, and ensuring our driving workforce is fully supported. Your responsibilities will include:
- Planning and coordinating driver shift coverage to ensure client staffing requirements are met, including managing short-notice changes and absences
- Meeting client requirements by sourcing and placing qualified HGV, LGV, and professional drivers
- Recruiting, screening, interviewing, and onboarding driving candidates
- Verifying licences, CPC qualifications, digital tachograph cards, and conducting compliance checks
- Managing driver availability, shift bookings, and rota planning
- Accurately processing payroll data and validating driver hours
- Handling driver queries, absences, holiday requests, and shift changes
- Ensuring compliance with transport legislation, client requirements, and recruitment best practice
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with both clients and drivers
- Proactively addressing staffing challenges and sourcing solutions to meet operational demands
- Supporting out-of-hours requirements when necessary to ensure service continuity

The Skills You'll Develop as a Recruitment Account Coordinator

At Staffline, you'll receive ongoing coaching, development, and support to help you reach your full potential. In this role, you'll develop expertise in:
- Driving and transport recruitment
- Client relationship management
- Workforce planning and resource allocation
- Driver compliance and industry regulations
- Candidate attraction and retention strategies
- Performance management and service delivery
- Problem-solving and operational decision-making

We actively encourage career progression and offer clear development pathways for those looking to advance their careers within recruitment and account management.

What We Need From You

We're committed to helping you succeed, but to thrive in this role you'll need:
- The ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and solve problems effectively
- A customer-focused approach with a genuine passion for people
- Experience within recruitment, transport, logistics, driving operations, or a customer service environment (preferred but not essential)
- Strong organisation skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
- A keen eye for detail, particularly when handling compliance documentation
- A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of challenges
- Confidence working in a fast-paced environment where responsiveness is key
- Most importantly: tenacity, resilience, flexibility, and a positive attitude towards delivering exceptional service

Diversity and Inclusion: A Core Focus

At Staffline, we are deeply committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe that a diverse team brings different perspectives, ideas, and experiences, enhancing our overall effectiveness and success. We value and celebrate the uniqueness of each individual, and we actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Intrigued? Why not apply now? Or if you need more information, get in touch!

Note: All candidates must demonstrate their Right to Work in the UK. A full UK driver's license is highly desired for this role.

title: HR Assistant
description:
Elevation HR are delighted to be recruiting for an experienced HR Administrator / HR Assistant on behalf of a well-established organisation based in Doncaster on a full-time, permanent basis.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with HR administration experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced, process-driven environment and is looking to develop their HR career within a busy, supportive team.

The business is currently undergoing an exciting HR transformation, including the implementation of new systems and processes, making this a fantastic time to join. Working within a centralised HR function, you'll support the wider HR team and HR Business Partners with a broad range of employee lifecycle administration, recruitment coordination, absence management and HR systems administration.

As a HR Assistant you will be:
- Supporting recruitment activity including interview coordination, issuing offers and contracts, onboarding administration and pre-employment checks
- Managing and maintaining HR systems
- Supporting absence management processes, maintaining records, monitoring documentation and producing reports

- Preparing HR correspondence
- Liaising with payroll regarding starters, leavers and employee changes
- Maintaining organisational charts, HR trackers and reporting data
- Supporting the administration of employee benefits
- Producing HR reports and analysing data using Excel
- Acting as a key point of contact for HR-related queries

Benefits as a HR Assistant include:
- Hybrid Working - 2 Days Working from home following probation
- Early Friday Finish
- 25 Days Annual Leave plus bank holidays
- Additional days leave for birthday

What we're looking for from a HR Assistant:
- Previous experience within a HR Administrator, Assistant or Coordination role
- Strong understanding of core HR processes including recruitment administration, absence management and employee lifecycle activities
- Confidence managing high volumes of administration with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable working across multiple HR systems and databases
- Strong communication skills with the confidence to pick up the phone and build relationships across the business
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
- CIPD Level 3 qualification (or working towards) is desirable

We're keen to speak with driven, organised and detail-focused HR professionals who enjoy being part of a busy team and take pride in delivering a first-class HR service. For more details, get in touch with Demi Fearn.
